content: निर्मित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Constructed, built, formed, prepared, made <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 (in law) Fixed, settled; एवं धर्मं विजानीमः प्राक् प्रजापतिनिर्मितम् <ls>Ms. 9. 46</ls>. .²3 Artificial. .²4 Performed, celebrated (a ceremony); ज्योतिष्टोमायुषी चैवमतिरात्रौ च निर्मितौ <ls>Rām. 1. 14. 42</ls>.
